pairs.l: 8 — felt they didn't get their money's worth?

r1.exp: 1=E (Eddie: 'I'd forgotten how dirty the place was' = bio je tamo ranije). 2=E (Eddie: 'it gave me a slimline look I was quite proud of while it lasted'). 3=B (Bela: 'it's a fascinating city and should be on everyone's list'). 4=F (Faye: 'I had to force the meals down me'). 5=A (Alf: 'generally cloudy so I didn't get back with the tan I'd been hoping for'). 6=C (Cameron: 'when I got out at the top, I was so high that I couldn't open my eyes'). 7=B (Bela: 'the experience of being alone and coping makes me think I'll be able to deal with challenges better'). 8=F (Faye: 'I'd have expected more for the price I paid'). 9=D (Dawn: 'I felt quite left out'). 10=E (Eddie: 'I came down with something that took me a couple of days to recover from'). 11=A (Alf: 'I wish I'd taken a book to occupy my mind'). 12=D (Dawn: 'I went quite over budget').

r13.exp: 'After a few crashes, he was on his way' = naučio sam, prateći brata ali praktički SAM = D (on his own). Brat mu je bio uzor ali nije ga aktivno učio.

r14.exp: 'He felt he could go ANYWHERE HE WANTED. He was NO LONGER RESTRICTED' = osjećaj slobode = A.

r15.exp: 'He had the PERFECT BUILD for a long-distance cyclist' — trener ga je odmah primijetio zbog tijela = A (His body/physique).

r16.exp: 'He had opted to learn from Broad, ONE OF THE BEST COACHES IN THE COUNTRY, and improve his technique' = radi vrhunskog treninga = C.

r17.exp: 'I'VE ONLY GOT MYSELF TO BLAME' = njegova krivnja = C (his fault).

r18.exp: 'I was DETERMINED TO COME BACK next year and win the tour' = vidio to kao izazov = B (He saw it as a challenge).

r19.exp: 'Wrote a book encouraging families to do something similar. (19)___' → F: And recently they carried this message to the teenagers of Marymount. Logičan nastavak — proširuju poruku.

r20.exp: 'Kevin said if WE didn't have a nice car... (20)___. By dinnertime, Hannah was all worked up.' → H: This sank in rather more deeply than he'd intended. Kevin nije htio izazvati takvu reakciju.

r21.exp: 'They explained all they already do. (21)___. THAT was annoying, so Joan said sell the house?' → G: Hannah rolled her eyes. Hannah je podcjenjivala roditeljske napore.

r22.exp: 'Your contribution can be different. (22)___. If you watch six hours of TV, cut to three.' → A: And everyone has something they can spare. Svaka osoba može nešto dati — uvod primjeru s TV-om.

r23.exp: 'Woman asked how friends had reacted. (23)___. Friends had been baffled, or worse.' → E: This had been a problem. Reakcija prijatelja bila je problematična.

r24.exp: 'The world is a largely connected community. (24)___. Today I took out clothes...' → B: I owe that to you. Studentica zahvaljuje Salwenovima za inspirirano djelovanje.

r25.exp: 'A VARIED climate' — pridjev 'varied' = raznovrstan (ispred imenice). 'Various' = razni (ne ispred 'climate' s članom 'a').

r26.exp: 'DESPITE its ever-changing weather' — 'despite' + imenička skupina. 'In spite of' tražilo bi 'of'. 'Regardless of' tražilo bi 'of'.

r27.exp: 'THE MAIN influence on the climate' — određeni član 'the' za superlativni/jedinstven pojam (the main = glavni, jedini).

r28.exp: 'It helps KEEP winters less cold' — 'help' + infinitiv bez 'to' (bare infinitive): help keep. 'Help' se ne slaže s gerundom.

r29.exp: 'Cooler than THOSE on the continent' — 'those' = onima (British summers = plural → those summers on the continent).

r30.exp: 'Subject to FEW extremes' — 'few' uz brojivu imenicu množine (extremes). 'Little' uz nebrojivu. 'Few' = malo, rijetko.

r31.exp: 'ON average' — fiksna kolokacija: on average = prosječno, u prosjeku.

r32.exp: 'If you VISIT the mountainous areas' — uvjetna rečenica 1. tipa (realni uvjet): if + present simple.

r33.exp: 'Not only among linguists... BUT also among all interested' — fiksni izraz: not only... but (also) = ne samo... nego i.

r34.exp: 'Dealing WITH language issues' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: deal with = baviti se (nečim).

r35.exp: 'What is BEING done' — present continuous passive: is being done = što se trenutno radi.

r36.exp: '6,000 or SO languages' — '6,000 or so' = otprilike 6,000 (or so = ili otprilike, around).

r37.exp: 'Will BE dominated by' — future simple passive: will + be + past participle.

r38.exp: 'An alarming trend, WHICH... is both peculiarly modern' — ne-restriktivna relativna zamjenica 'which' (uz zarez, odnosi se na 'trend').

r39.exp: 'Pursuing the subject FURTHER' — 'further' = dalje, dublje (pursue further = istražiti dublje).

r40.exp: 'A leading authority ON language' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: an authority on = autoritet za/o nečemu.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA zamjenu: smanjuje fizičke kontakte, površni online odnosi, ovisnost, manje kvalitetnog vremena s obitelji. PROTIV (tj. ZA obogaćivanje): ostajanje u kontaktu s dalekima, dijeljenje iskustava, brza komunikacija. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
